collapsedTitle.simpleText: Sam Altman discusses the early days of OpenAI and the evolution of AI capabilities from early models to the public release of ChatGPT. They explore the scientific approach to predicting model behavior, the importance of reinforcement learning with human feedback, and the distinction between knowledge and reasoning in large language models.
